description: Synthetic capture contains two day records for the SAME session_date 2025-06-02 with conflicting status (OPEN vs CLOSED). Exercises duplicate-date conflict detection.
expected_contract_outcome: If both revisions are visible at as_of and disagree, selection raises PITConflictError. If a newer revision supersedes the older unambiguously, the single latest revision is selected. Duplicate dates must never be silently averaged.
warnings: SYNTHETIC_FIXTURE_ONLY: not real data; sha256 values are placeholders.
Duplicate session_date with conflicting payload is a conflict, not a duplicate to drop.
